description: 1 x Oak (applicants ref. T1) - Diameter at 1.5m - 0.4m. Height - 15m. Crown Spread Diameter - 14m. Reduce height by up to 1.5m and lateral spread on all sides by up to 1.5m.1 x Honey Locust (applicants ref. T2) - Diameter at 1.5m - 0.4m. Height - 14m. Crown Spread Diameter - 14m. Reduce height by up to 2m and lateral spread on all sides by up to 1.5m.1 x Honey Locust (applicants ref. T3) - Diameter at 1.5m - 0.3m. Height - 10m. Crown Spread Diameter - 5m. Reduce height by up to 2-3m only.1 x Unidentifiable Shrub (applicants ref. T4) - Diameter at 1.5m - 0.2m. Height - 6m. Crown Spread Diameter - 6m. Reduce height by up to 1m and lateral spread on all sides by up to 1m.1 x Blue Spruce (applicants ref. T5) - Reduce height by up to 2-3m and remove any major dead wood over 200mm and or over 1m in length.1 x Hornbeam (applicants ref. T6) - Diameter at 1.5m - 0.3m. Height - 12m. Crown Spread Diameter - 7m. Reduce height by up to 1m and lateral spread on all sides by up to 1m. Crown lift by 1.5-2m.Leyland Cypress Hedge (applicants ref. H1) - Height - 3m. Remove lower dead wood / brown branches on the pedestrian side only.Mixed Species Group (applicants ref. G1) - Height - 6-7m. Reduce height by up to 2m, trim back side overhanging roof to give 0.5m clearance.
